inputs.name: Samples
inputs.description: One row per pair_id. No Flow samples required: type a pair_id and pick a directory for each platform. Raw inputs are directories; the stub treats them as opaque paths, so any directory works for a dummy run.

samplesheet.name: Samplesheet
samplesheet.description: CSV with one row per pair_id.

columns.name: merscope_dir
columns.description: Directory selected as data (required for paired/merscope modes).

columns.name: xenium_dir
columns.description: Directory selected as data (required for paired/xenium modes).

inputs.name: Analysis options
inputs.description: For a dummy run, set Stop stage to 'enrich' and turn MECR off so no reference data is needed.

outputs.name: Segmentation
outputs.description: Cellpose masks and ProSeg base SpatialData .zarr.

outputs.name: Enrichment
outputs.description: Per-shape assignment summaries and updated latest SpatialData .zarr.
